environment.noise: Shared workstation; other Flow agents and background apps may run concurrently. No CPU/network throttling, no claim of isolation.

boundaries.a: HTTP localhost gzip/no-store; JSON.parse only for parseMs; expandDomMs ends at DOM text assignment, not paint; hash verification excluded from expansion timer. encodedBodyBytes is browser-observed compressed body; transferBytes is Resource Timing header+body counter, not TCP/TLS packet capture.
boundaries.b: Same 8192 deterministic events, 128 agents. Immediate writes once/event; batched processes all events in chunks of 1024 and coalesces display writes per agent. MutationObserver counts real characterData mutations only inside grid. queuedControlDelayMs is in-browser setTimeout(0)->synthetic button handler; not Playwright command latency, human input, or INP. completionMs ends at final DOM assignment; batching includes frame waits. Long tasks overlap this window; no forced layout/busy-wait. Two final rAFs only flush observer delivery, not paint measurements.
boundaries.percentiles: Nearest-rank p50/p95 of 20 valid measurements per mode; warmups excluded. No p99/SLO.
